Constant challenge - I challenge everything. I ask big questions and I ask dumb questions often. Some examples that I am currently working on:

  • What am I?
  • What influence can a person, or a group of people have on the collective consciousness or society itself?
  • A million questions about the nature of societies and studying how small (sometimes comparatively insignificant things) can play major roles in change
  • Why things are the way they are - stratification, power structures, history
  • How can I get better, little by little? Why is getting better important to me (or others)?
  • Asking questions to others about their opinions and why they see things the way they do (in particular, those with objectionable opinions); trying to understand things that I will never agree with

These are just a few examples - for me, simply thinking about all this stuff is not enough though. My mind becomes like a dumpster that doesn't get emptied if I can't have an exchange of ideas with others. I need others' to challenge my perspective to keep new ideas flowing.
